meta.title: PS基础：什么是图层与蒙版

scenes.context: 老师在白板上画示意图，用「楼层」类比引入「图层」概念。
sentences: 很多房子叠在一起叫楼层，很多图片叠在一起叫图层。
Many houses stacked together are called floors; many images stacked together are called layers.
叠在一起：stacked together
图层有很多类型，比如照片、字体、形状、调色图层。
There are many types of layers, such as photo, text, shape, and color-adjustment layers.
调色图层：color-adjustment layer / adjustment layer
你想让什么显示在前面，就把它的图层放在最上面。
Whatever you want to appear in front, put its layer at the top.
放在最上面：put it at the top
paraphrase: 图片一层层叠起来的「层」→ 图层的本质
A layer is simply one image stacked on top of another.
想显示在前→ 放最上面
To show something in front, drag it to the top of the stack.
scenes.speak: What is a layer? Many houses stacked together are called floors; many images stacked together are called layers. There are many types of layers, such as photo, text, shape, and color-adjustment layers. Whatever you want to appear in front, put its layer at the top.

scenes.title_en: A mask hides part of a layer
scenes.context: 老师介绍蒙版的唯一功能，并用黑白画笔演示隐藏与还原。
sentences: 所有图层都可以加蒙版，而蒙版的功能只有一个。
Every layer can have a mask, and a mask has only one job.
功能只有一个：has only one job
用黑色画笔可以隐藏你不想要的部分。
Use a black brush to hide the parts you don't want.
黑色画笔：black brush
白色画笔可以还原你想保留的部分，两个画面拼起来形成新画面。
Use a white brush to bring back the parts you want, and the two images merge into a new one.
还原：bring back / restore
paraphrase: 隐藏不要的部分→ 用黑色画笔涂
Paint over the unwanted part in black to hide it.
两幅画面拼起来→ 合成新画面
Combine the two images to create a brand-new picture.
scenes.speak: Every layer can have a mask, and a mask has only one job: hiding part of the layer. Use a black brush to hide the parts you don't want. Use a white brush to bring back the parts you want, and the two images merge into a new one.

scenes.context: 老师用曲线调色图层演示蒙版的实际用途，并总结应用方向。
sentences: 曲线往上提，整个画面会变亮。
Raising the curve makes the whole image brighter.
往上提：raise it up
不想让某个部分受影响，就在蒙版里涂黑。
To keep an area unaffected, paint it black on the mask.
受影响：be affected
可以做一些海报合成、平面设计，以及摄影的局部调色。
You can do poster compositing, graphic design, and localized color grading in photography.
局部调色：localized color grading
paraphrase: 整体变亮→ 影响全局
The whole image gets brighter when you raise the curve.
只影响部分→ 用蒙版控制范围
Use a mask to control exactly where the adjustment applies.
scenes.speak: Raising the curve makes the whole image brighter. To keep an area unaffected, paint it black on the mask. With these tools, you can do poster compositing, graphic design, and localized color grading in photography.

practice: 描述「一叠纸」的概念：把纸叠在一起
Stack the sheets of paper together.
说明「把某物放最上面」的操作
Put the photo layer at the very top.
表达「恢复/还原」某个部分
Use a white brush to restore the part you want to keep.
The mask limits the adjustment to the selected area.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Layer is a thing that many pictures on it.
✓ 地道说法：A layer is simply one image stacked on top of another.
用名词性描述代替生硬的定语从句。
✕ 直译腔：Use black brush hide the part.
✓ 地道说法：Paint the unwanted part black to hide it.
英文常用「paint + 颜色」表达涂色动作。
✕ 直译腔：The mask only has one function that is hide.
✓ 地道说法：A mask has only one job: hiding part of a layer.
用冒号补足解释，比 that is 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Let the picture become bright.
✓ 地道说法：Raising the curve makes the image brighter.
动词名词化（raising）是教学语境常用表达。
shifts: 把图层当作「拼在一起的图片」
把图层当作「决定显示顺序的堆叠」
把蒙版当作「擦除像素的橡皮擦」
把蒙版当作「可逆的局部显隐开关」
调色只能作用于整个图层
用蒙版把调整限定在局部区域
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「手背移动图层」按上下文校正为「拖动移动图层」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
